clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Discusses Political Memoir And National History In India
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi has published a new memoir titled Belonging which details her transition from Italy to Indian political life.
The book provides a personal perspective on the assassination of her husband and mother-in-law alongside her view on national political evolution.

clusters.headline: Severe Smog Envelops New Delhi Amidst Ongoing Air Quality Concerns
aiSummaryBullets: Air quality in New Delhi reached the severe category following the use of firecrackers during the recent Deepavali festival.
Multiple government air quality monitoring stations in the capital region experienced data outages during the peak pollution period.

clusters.headline: Fatal Altercation Follows Scooter Collision Incident In Noida
aiSummaryBullets: A 25-year-old individual died following a dispute that escalated into a physical clash.
The incident was reportedly triggered by a collision between scooters.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Engages In Diplomatic And Domestic Political Talk
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Modi held discussions with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy regarding peace efforts in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict.
The Prime Minister celebrated Diwali with security personnel in Bastar, highlighting the region's transition following the end of Naxalism.

clusters.headline: India And Global Communities Celebrate The Annual Diwali Festival
aiSummaryBullets: Diwali festivities across India include prayer services, traditional rangoli patterns, fireworks, and the sharing of sweets.
Major celebrations were held in Ayodhya, involving drone displays, light shows, and theatrical performances based on the Hindu epic Ramayana.

clusters.headline: Qantas Announces Plans To Outsource Eight Hundred Fifty Local Jobs
aiSummaryBullets: Qantas intends to outsource 850 corporate roles to the consultancy firm Accenture.
The airline stated that a majority of these positions will be relocated to India.

clusters.headline: 'It's ridiculous': Ex-India coach questions Yashasvi Jaiswal's ODI snub
aiSummaryBullets: Times of India reports: 'It's ridiculous': Ex-India coach questions Yashasvi Jaiswal's ODI snub

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Details Life And Family In New Memoir Belonging
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi has released a new memoir titled Belonging: A Journey of Love.
The book includes anecdotes about Indira Gandhi's temperament and household dynamics.

clusters.headline: Regional Authorities Expand Ethanol Fuel Testing Following Concerns
aiSummaryBullets: Keralam authorities have begun collecting petrol samples from various fuel stations to verify ethanol content following reports from Karnataka.
Karnataka officials conducted tests at 67 locations after finding ethanol levels reaching up to 31% in samples, exceeding the mandated E20 blend.
